Ted Wacker Joins Speaking Panel at CSIMS PI University 2023

We are thrilled to announce that Ted Wacker, a distinguished attorney at TBW Law, has been invited to join the esteemed speaking panel at the CSIMS PI University 2023. This prestigious event, renowned for its focus on personal injury law, will feature a panel titled "From ER to Courtroom: Building Your Case and Knowing When to Refer It Out."

Event Overview

CSIMS PI University is a premier annual conference that brings together leading personal injury professionals, including attorneys, medical experts, and industry specialists. The event offers a platform for sharing insights, strategies, and best practices in personal injury law. This year, the conference will address critical topics related to personal injury case management, from the initial emergency room visit to courtroom proceedings.

Ted Wacker’s Expertise

Ted Wacker’s participation in the panel is a testament to his extensive expertise and respected position in the field of personal injury law. With years of experience and a track record of successful case outcomes, Ted brings invaluable knowledge and insights to the panel. His commitment to securing justice for clients and his ability to navigate complex legal landscapes make him an ideal speaker for this topic.

Panel Discussion: From ER to Courtroom

The panel discussion, "From ER to Courtroom: Building Your Case and Knowing When to Refer It Out," will explore the critical steps involved in managing a personal injury case. Topics will include:

  • The importance of thorough initial medical evaluations and documentation.
  • Effective strategies for building a strong legal case from the onset.
  • Key considerations for determining when to refer a case to specialized medical or legal professionals.
  • Best practices for collaboration between legal and medical teams to ensure comprehensive client care and successful case outcomes.

Why This Matters

Participation in this panel not only highlights Ted Wacker’s expertise but also underscores TBW Law’s commitment to staying at the forefront of personal injury law. By engaging in such high-level discussions, we continue to refine our strategies and approaches, ensuring that our clients receive the best possible representation and outcomes.

Join Us at CSIMS PI University 2023

We encourage our clients, colleagues, and friends to join us at CSIMS PI University 2023 to gain valuable insights from industry leaders like Ted Wacker. The knowledge shared at this event will benefit all attendees, enhancing their understanding and capabilities in handling personal injury cases.

Conclusion

TBW Law is proud to see Ted Wacker recognized for his expertise and honored to have him represent our firm at CSIMS PI University 2023. We look forward to the insights and strategies he will share, which will undoubtedly contribute to the continued excellence and success of our legal practice.

For more information about TBW Law and our commitment to providing exceptional legal representation, please visit our website or contact us directly. We are dedicated to fighting for justice and securing the best outcomes for our clients.

title: Hernandez Settlement Documentary
metaTitle: TBW Law blog / Hernandez Settlement Documentary
metaDescription: TBW Quadruples Initial Settlement Offer on Behalf of Renee Hernandez and Family.
author: By TBW Law
bodyHtml:
‍

$12.65 Million Settlement - Ted Wacker, Esq. Quadruples Initial Settlement OfferAttorney Ted Wacker, of Southern California firm TBW Law, secured the largest settlement of any case partnered with DK Global in 2016. He was able to reach a settlement of $12.65 million on behalf of a college soccer player who was severely injured after being struck by a speeding semi-truck. The Plaintiff was driving on I-605 when he lost control of the vehicle and ended up stalled on the highway. Multiple vehicles, including another semi-truck, were able to safely maneuver around the Plaintiff and one driver, who is referred to as Mr. Salazar in the feature video, even pulled over to assist him. The Defendant in the matter, however, was driving recklessly and struck the Plaintiff's vehicle at a high rate of speed. As a result of the collision, the Plaintiff sustained brain hemorrhaging, multiple fractures and other injuries that have completely changed his lifestyle.

The defense team initially offered about $3 million to settle the matter, but Attorney Wacker knew that the degree to which Renee Hernandez' life was affected by the collision and the level of negligence from the semi-truck driver warranted a significantly greater settlement amount. Attorney Wacker and his team were confident in their ability to achieve justice, despite the challenges faced to reach that goal. The defense claimed that the Defendant could not see the vehicle because the Plaintiff's lights were not functional at the time of the collision. However, Attorney Wacker made certain to highlight witness testimony that stated other vehicles, including another semi-truck, avoided the collision. To bolster his argument, Attorney Wacker contacted DK Global for an accurate reconstruction of the collision. At every step of the production process, Attorney Wacker was an involved, proactive and knowledgeable representor for his client. With the new visual presentation and his own tenacity, Attorney Wacker was able to end 2016 on a high note and deliver justice and future security from the burden of medical bills and loss of wages to his client in the amount of $12.65 million.

title: What to do When You Are Rejected by an Insurance Company
metaTitle: TBW Law blog / What to do When You Are Rejected by an Insurance Company
metaDescription: Insurance companies play a key role in this process, offering settlements that ideally should cover your unforeseen expenses.
author: By TBW Law
bodyHtml:
After an accident, you're likely dealing with physical pain, emotional stress, and financial worries. Understanding your legal rights becomes crucial as you navigate through these challenging times. Insurance companies play a key role in this process, offering settlements that ideally should cover your unforeseen expenses.

However, what if the settlement offer from the insurance company doesn’t meet your expectations? It’s important to know that you, usually through your attorney, have the right to reject their proposal.

What Happens After Rejecting a Settlement Offer?Rejecting a settlement offer leads to the crucial step of drafting and presenting a counteroffer. This involves demanding a higher sum that adequately covers all your losses related to the accident or injury. This marks the beginning of intense negotiations to reach a fair agreement.

Backing up your claim with solid evidence is key. This includes providing medical records that detail your hospital visits, treatments, and prognosis. It’s essential to include all medical-related expenses, such as medication costs, hospital bills, physical therapy, and other related costs.

Additionally, you should provide proof of lost income resulting directly from your injury or accident. This demonstrates the financial impact the incident has had on your life.

The Path to LitigationIf negotiations don’t result in a satisfactory settlement, filing a personal injury lawsuit becomes an option. This legal process involves several stages, including discovery, more negotiations, and potentially a court trial.

It’s critical to consider both the risks and benefits of litigation:

The outcome of a lawsuit is never guaranteed.Trials can be lengthy, adding to the emotional and financial strain.Legal costs might increase, as attorneys typically charge a higher percentage for trial cases.Trials can be emotionally taxing due to uncertainty and potential public exposure.Deciding whether to proceed with a trial should be made after discussing the potential risks and rewards with your attorney.

FAQs

How Should You Respond to a Low Insurance Settlement Offer?Don’t rush to accept a low offer. Evaluate it carefully to see if it covers your medical bills, property damage, and lost income. Consult with an experienced personal injury attorney like those at TBW Law Firm to determine if it’s a fair offer, and submit a well-supported counteroffer.

**When Is It Advisable

to Reject a Settlement Offer?**Reject a settlement offer if it doesn't adequately cover your expenses, including medical costs and lost income, or if it fails to account for future costs related to your injury. Also, consider rejecting if your pain and suffering are undervalued or if the investigation by the insurance company is insufficient.

How Long Do You Have to Accept a Settlement Offer?While insurance companies may set specific deadlines, it’s crucial to be aware of the legal time frames. In personal injury cases, the statute of limitations typically sets a two-year window to file a lawsuit. It’s vital to handle insurance claims well before this period lapses, especially if considering rejecting the offer.

What Happens After Accepting a Settlement Offer?Once you accept a settlement, you'll likely sign a Release form, preventing future claims for the same incident. After processing, which might involve deductions for legal fees and medical liens, you'll receive your settlement check.

Why Contact TBW Law Firm for Your Settlement OfferNavigating insurance settlement offers can be complex and requires skilled legal evaluation and negotiation. TBW Law Firm’s expertise ensures that you receive fair compensation for your injuries. Contact us for a no-cost initial consultation and expert guidance through your personal injury claim.

title: Checklist: Preparing for Your Accident Attorney Meeting
metaTitle: TBW Law blog / Checklist: Preparing for Your Accident Attorney Meeting
metaDescription: To make the most of this crucial meeting, it's important to be well-prepared.
author: By TBW Law
bodyHtml:
Are you scheduled to meet with an accident attorney soon? To make the most of this crucial meeting, it's important to be well-prepared. Here's a checklist to help you organize your thoughts and documents, ensuring you're ready to discuss your case thoroughly:

  1. Accident Details: Compile a detailed account of the accident. Include date, time, location, and how the accident occurred.
  2. Photographic Evidence: Gather any photos or videos from the accident scene, including pictures of injuries and damages.
  3. Police Report: If a police report was filed, obtain a copy. This report is a key piece of documentation for your case.
  4. Medical Records: Bring all medical records related to injuries from the accident. This includes hospital visits, treatment plans, prescriptions, and diagnoses.
  5. Expense Records: Compile a list of all expenses incurred due to the accident, such as medical bills, rehabilitation costs, and lost wages.
  6. Insurance Information: Have your insurance details handy, as well as any communication you've had with insurance companies post-accident.
  7. Witness Information: If there were witnesses, bring their contact information and statements, if available.
  8. Personal Notes: Include any personal notes or a journal you’ve kept detailing the accident's impact on your daily life and well-being.
  9. Questions for the Attorney: Write down any questions or concerns you have for your attorney about your case or the legal process.
  10. Open Mind: Be prepared to listen and take notes. Your attorney may provide insights or suggest strategies that hadn't occurred to you.

Organizing these items before your meeting will help your attorney understand your case better and provide you with more accurate advice. Remember, the more information you can provide, the more effectively your attorney can advocate on your behalf.
